rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something perfect and without faults, including a person's work or language.

example.english: Her report is impeccable, without even a single typo.
example.traditional: 佢份報告寫得好完美，連一個錯字都冇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 jyun4 mei5 lin4 jat1 go3 co3 zi6 dou1 mou5

rows.note: Use this colloquial praise when saying that something is so good that there is nothing to criticise.

example.english: The food at this restaurant tonight is impeccable; everyone ate every last bite.
example.traditional: 今晚間餐廳啲菜真係冇得彈，大家食到清碟。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 coi3 zan1 hai6 mou5 dak1 taan4 daai6 gaa1 sik6 dou2 cing1 dip6

rows.note: Choose this more formal wording when stressing that no fault can be found, especially in careful or written language.

example.english: The panel unanimously considered this research report impeccable.
example.traditional: 評審一致認為呢份研究報告無可挑剔。
example.jyutping: ping4 sam2 jat1 zi3 jing6 wai4 ne1 fan6 jin4 gau3 bou3 gou3 mou4 ho2 tiu1 tik1
